📰 General

Meta Axes AI Photo Tool After Massive User Backlash Over Data Collection •

Meta has abruptly discontinued its new AI photo generation tool following widespread public criticism. The feature, released on July 7th, automatically utilized face data from public Instagram accounts without user consent. Users expressed significant concern regarding the tool’s privacy implications and the potential for unauthorized data harvesting. Meta stated that it was responding to the overwhelming negative feedback and would be focusing on other AI initiatives.

🌍 World

Ukraine’s Largest Defense Firm Accused of Illegal Weapons Storage Near Civilians •

President Volodymyr Zelensky announced on July 11th that top officials at Ukroboronprom, Ukraine’s state-owned defense conglomerate, illegally stored weapons depots in Vyshneve, a Kyiv suburb. The storage locations violated Ukrainian law and posed a significant risk to civilian populations. Investigations are underway to determine the extent of the illegal storage and the individuals involved. This incident raises concerns about oversight and security within Ukraine’s defense industry.

🦅 US

Czech Duo Claims Wimbledon Final Victory: Nosková and Muchová Dominate •

Linda Nosková secured a dominant victory over Marta Kostyuk in the Wimbledon women’s final, advancing her and Karolína Muchová to the championship match. The Czech pair achieved a 6-4, 6-4 win, marking a significant moment for Czech tennis. This all-Czech final promises a unique spectacle on the grass courts of the All England Club. The outcome guarantees a Czech champion will be crowned at Wimbledon 2026.

💰 Business

Surprisingly Affordable: This U.S. City Leads in Cheap Cheeseburger Costs •

A recent DoorDash State of Local Commerce report identified Memphis, Tennessee, as the most affordable place in the United States to purchase a cheeseburger, fries, and a soda. The study analyzed prices across 60 major U.S. cities, finding that the combo averaged $7.38 in Memphis. This represents a significant difference compared to the national average of $9.78. The report attributed the lower prices to a combination of factors including lower labor costs and a competitive restaurant market.

💻 Technology

Boyfriend’s Screen Share Reveals Dating Apps, Sparking Online Debate •

A woman discovered her boyfriend had multiple dating app profiles on his phone after he inadvertently shared his screen during a FaceTime call. The Reddit user, who posted about the incident on r/GirlDinnerDiaries, stated the accidental screen sharing revealed he was using apps like Hinge. The revelation prompted discussion and speculation within the online community regarding the boyfriend’s actions. The incident highlights the potential privacy concerns associated with screen sharing technology.

🎭 Entertainment

‘Police Academy’ Star Peter Van Norden Passes Away at 75 •

Peter Van Norden, known for his role in the 1984 comedy “Police Academy,” has died at the age of 75. He passed away peacefully at a Southern California hospice facility on Thursday morning. His wife, Wendy, confirmed the actor’s death. Van Norden’s career spanned several comedic films throughout the 1980s and 1990s.

🏅 Sports

Giants Secure Future Ace: Jackson Flora Selected Fourth Overall in 2026 Draft •

The San Francisco Giants utilized the fourth overall pick in the 2026 MLB Draft to select right-handed pitcher Jackson Flora. Flora, who plays for UCSB, was chosen to address a significant need within the Giants’ organization. Scouts have praised Flora’s impressive fastball and command. This selection marks a key investment for the Giants’ long-term pitching strategy.

🔬 Science

MIT Robot Achieves Seamless Flight and Underwater Navigation with Single Wings •

Researchers at MIT have developed a miniature robot capable of transitioning between aerial and aquatic movement utilizing a single set of wings. The robot, created by Raphael Zufferey’s team, employs a flexible wing design that adapts to different fluid dynamics. The device successfully demonstrates the ability to fly through the air and then submerge itself underwater without requiring any additional components or mechanisms. This innovative design represents a significant advancement in robotics and fluid dynamics research.

🩺 Health

Cyclospora Outbreak Spreads Nationwide, Michigan Faces Highest Case Count •

A widespread outbreak of Cyclospora, causing explosive diarrhea, has now affected over 1,700 individuals across the United States. Health officials are investigating the source of the parasite, which is linked to contaminated fresh produce. Michigan currently leads in confirmed cases, with approximately 1,500 additional cases awaiting confirmation. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) advises individuals to practice thorough food safety measures, particularly when consuming raw fruits and vegetables.
